issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: lectern, melon, pumpkin, red_banner, white_banner, red_wool, white_wool, yellow_wool, chiseled_stone_bricks, stone_brick_wall.
562 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.detail: Open stalls with goods (melons, pumpkins, hay), hanging lanterns, wall signs, lectern scale, strongbox, lantern posts and banner poles.
notes.roof: Flat stepped wool awnings; the yellow fringe on two awnings adds colour but there is still no pitch.
notes.life: Lanterns and produce; no plants yet (L3).
notes.grandeur: The tall chiseled cross head with hanging lanterns now anchors the square.

visual.summary: Level 2 opens the stalls for trade and makes the square a proper market: a tall cross head with lanterns, a weighing lectern, a strongbox, goods on the counters, lantern posts and banner poles at the entrances.
problems: Note only: meta.groundLayer 0, the paving replaces the grass.
Reachability: 180 of 282 standing places reached; unreached are awning tops (y 4..5) and the two cross-step tops at (6,6,7) and (8,6,7), which are fine. All stalls, counters and aisles are reached.
